notes: Half-rack-width, 1U-high (1.75"H x 8.75"W x 6.00"D) desktop/rack unit; rack mounting requires an optional accessory (MBU 123, RSU 126, or UTS 100 shelf kit) rather than built-in ears. Category/type: this is a 1-input-to-6-output video distribution amplifier (splitter), not a switcher/matrix in the strict sense (no input selection or crosspoint routing); "switcher" was chosen as the closest available category (matches this catalog's existing convention for Extron DXP/SW switching products) and no "type" enum value (Video switcher, Matrix router, Extender, Converter, etc.) accurately fits, so type was omitted. RS-232 port is physically a 3.5 mm 3-pole captive screw/terminal block, not a DB9 — mapped to "euroblock" (the only terminal-block connector id) rather than the "rs232" enum value. USB config port is Mini-B (not Micro-B) — mapped to "usb-micro" as the closest available id, per USB 2.0 spec stated by Extron. All grades (hdmi-2.0 on HDMI ports, usb-2.0 on the config port) are explicitly confirmed by Extron's own spec sheet (HDMI 2.0b/18.0 Gbps max; USB 2.0 standard). No Ethernet/network port on this model. Cross-checked against Extron's official setup guide (68-2880-51) and specifications PDF (68-3271-01 Rev A3), both fetched directly from media.extron.com.
